## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Hive
where: HiveRepository (uses), src/persistence/repositories.ts, component persistence

=====SOURCE-BEGIN
private readonly items = new Map<string, Hive>();
=====SOURCE-END=====

### B

where: BeekeepingService (defines), src/business/services.ts, component business

=====SOURCE-BEGIN
latestInspection: this.latestInspection(hive.id),
=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: A is the Hive entity itself. HiveRepository stores hive records: "private readonly items = new Map<string, Hive>();". B, Hive Status, appears to be a summary that BeekeepingService builds from a hive. It pulls in related data such as the latest inspection: "latestInspection: this.latestInspection(hive.id),". So B is a separate concept derived from the hive. It refers to the Hive by its id and adds other information. They are not the same thing under two names.
